how_to_run: Run after the matching Deconstruct eval has produced its workspace; grade with deconstruct-workspace/evals/grade-eval.sh. D3 needs no Deconstruct run.

evals.name: new-format-plan
evals.fixture: the saved workspace from Deconstruct eval I1 (sales pre-call brief)
evals.expected_output: A Design Plan with plan_version 4.0, autonomy and decomposition in frontmatter, a coverage table, and the node link titled Design plan.
expectations: The opening includes "Design decides how your workflow will be built: which AI building blocks it uses and how much it works out on its own."

Design writes `framework/[name]/design-plan.md` (not `design-spec.md`) with frontmatter `plan_version: 4.0`, `approved: false`, `autonomy:` (lowercase) and `decomposition: steps`, and no `definition_type`
The plan has a coverage table: each building block lists the labels it delivers, and every Step, D, I, W, R and G label in `requirements.md` appears in it
The fixed (policy) CRM step is kept unchanged and is not Autonomous
Involvement is Augmented because `Runs: with you`
Tools come from the step lines' `uses` tags; a `(you)` step maps to Human
The Workflow node's `# Artifacts` link is titled "Design plan" and the node's `autonomy:` matches the plan

evals.name: regulated-plan
evals.fixture: the saved workspace from Deconstruct eval I2 (regulated expense approval)
evals.expected_output: Regulation binds through fixed steps and gates; a fixed step is never Autonomous; Autonomous regulated work gets a per-run record; the risky combination is flagged.
expectations: Every `fixed (regulation)` step is kept unchanged and is never Autonomous (it may be Guided when the AI judges by the student's criteria)
The value-read decision stays Deterministic, and the plan names a separate reading check keyed `D1 reading`
The over-$5,000 gate is a human gate in the plan; Design's self-check confirms the level respects every R, G, fixed step and the `Runs:` line
If Design chooses Autonomous for any step, it tells the student why in plain words and the plan includes a record of what the AI did on each run

Variant (edit the requirements to `Runs: without you` and remove the analyst gate): with W1 present and an Autonomous plan, Design names the risky combination and asks the student to add a gate before the write or accept the risk
Variant (`Governing regime: Not sure — to check`): Design asks the student to confirm before choosing Autonomous

evals.name: old-formats-still-design
evals.fixture: examples/weekly-status-report (old step-driven) and an old goal-driven requirements file
evals.expected_output: Old step-driven files run today's path; old goal-driven files are treated as decomposition: domains.
expectations: Old step-driven file: Design runs today's path, using `External Action` for the write check, and writes `design-plan.md`; an existing `design-spec.md` is renamed `design-spec-YYYY-MM-DD.md` and the node link becomes "Design plan"
Old goal-driven file: Design treats it as `decomposition: domains`, reads `goal-driven-path.md`, and stays Autonomous
A file with no `## Path` and none of the old markers: Design asks rather than assumes
With no `Runs:` line, involvement falls back to today's gates rule
